term: one source of self-existence power for all self-links
definition: There exists one c such that every x satisfying through w x x has selfPowerFrom w x c. c is the same witness for all such x at this world. It is stronger than merely ascribing a common predicate and does not follow from bare modal necessity. The existential quantifier supplies a common witness; it does not assert that the power-source is unique before the proof.
